description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of NatSQL and TA-SQL across different categories, including Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled in the order of Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, while the vertical axis represents Execution Accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a pair of bars, with light blue bars denoting NatSQL and dark blue bars representing TA-SQL. The NatSQL bars have values of approximately 60.21, 39.64, 32.32, and 51.35 for Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, respectively, while the corresponding TA-SQL bars have values of approximately 63.14, 48.60, 36.11, and 56.19. The bars are grouped by category, with NatSQL and TA-SQL bars appearing side by side for each category. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the categories, and no bars are visually emphasized.
